title: Fleet mode switchboard: scaling presets, throughput roll-forward charts, and immutable change trail
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Provide a consolidated Console surface ("Mode Switchboard") for fleet operators to: pick scaling modes (Manual / Targeted / Predictive), apply per-fleet throughput guarantees, inspect roll-forward throughput and latency charts, and review an immutable change trail with diff/rollback affordances. The goal is to reduce configuration errors, make scaling decisions reversible and auditable, and surface metrics that validate throughput SLAs in real time.
acceptance_criteria: UI: Mode Switchboard panel available on fleet detail page with three mutually-exclusive modes: Manual, Targeted (target RPS/TPM), Predictive (forecast-based autoscaling)
UI: Throughput roll-forward chart shows historical capacity commits, allocated GPUs, average and 95th percentile latency, and reserve headroom with configurable time window (1h/6h/24h/7d)
Feature: Operators can set per-fleet throughput guarantees expressed as sustained tokens/sec or request/sec with a percentile (e.g., 99th 1k rps over 5m)
Feature: Every change to scaling mode, throughput guarantees, or autoscale policy is recorded to an immutable change trail with author, timestamp, rationale, and link to PR/Confluence
Feature: Change trail supports side-by-side diffs and a one-click revert that creates a canary rollback plan (does not auto-apply without confirmation)
Telemetry: Console surfaces rollforward validation that shows whether observed throughput meets the configured guarantee over the selected window
E2E: Create/modify mode + guarantee and observe correct API calls to control plane (validated by ENG integration tests)
Docs: Console help panel and short walkthrough added to product docs + internal runbook for on-call
Security: Only users with fleet.write role can change scaling mode or guarantees; audit logs must be exportable to customer KMS if requested
implementation_notes: Backend: Reuse existing fleet config API (ENG-45122) and extend model to store guarantee objects with metric type, value, percentile and window
Backend: Add immutable change event store (append-only) mapped to fleet id. Events should include metadata keys: actor_id, actor_name, reason, commit_sha (optional), origin (console, api, terraform)
Frontend: New Mode Switchboard component in Console, mobile-responsive, with progressive disclosure for advanced guarantees

Frontend: Throughput roll-forward chart implemented with existing telemetry service (ENG-46311). Chart should overlay config changes as vertical markers and allow hover-to-inspect historical commit metadata
Design: Work with DES-1345 for compact diff UI and accessible color palette for mode states
Safety: Revert flow must open a canary plan builder modal (pre-filled with previous config) and require explicit confirmation with a typed confirmation for P0 fleets
Migration: Existing fleets without guarantees should default to 'Manual' mode and show a non-modal CTA to configure guarantees
Testing: Add unit tests for capability gating, e2e Cypress scenarios for change trail and revert, and integration tests verifying control-plane API payloads
engineering_links: ENG-45122: fleet config API enhancement spec
ENG-46311: telemetry query endpoints for roll-forward charts
comments: 2026-02-27 — Aisha Khatri: Kickoff with Eng & Design. Agreed MVP modes: Manual, Targeted, Predictive. Predictive will initially use a simple horizon predictor (N-day moving average) and be labeled experimental.
2026-03-02 — Marco Chen (eng): Backend schema drafted; change-event-store will be append-only and sharded by fleet-id. Will add retention policy enforcement for 90/365 day choices.
2026-03-04 — Lina Park (design): Shared diffs mockups. Revert flow mock requires typed confirmation for fleets with >$50k/mo spend.

2026-03-07 — Marco Chen (eng): Need decision on whether guarantees are enforced by control-plane admission controller or advisory only. Prefer admission controller for Dedicated customers with SLA contracts.
2026-03-11 — Security (E. Ramos): Audit export format should support downstream ingestion into customer SIEM; adding schema doc to engineering_links

2026-03-12 — Aisha Khatri: Updated acceptance criteria to require exportable audit logs and canary rollback modal. Assigned engineering tasks and blocked on ENG-46311 telemetry optimizations for 95th percentile queries
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Predictive mode might under-provision during sudden spikes — Mitigation: initially mark experimental and enforce fallback to Targeted/Manual when confidence low
Risk: Large audit trail size for long-lived fleets — Mitigation: retention policy (default 90 days) + optional longer retention for enterprise customers (export to S3/KMS)
Risk: Misconfiguration could lead to costly over-provisioning — Mitigation: show estimated monthly cost delta before applying changes and require billing approver for big accounts
Risk: Rollback could cause cascading thrash if not staged — Mitigation: revert flow creates a canary plan and preview of traffic delta; require cooldown window
qa_plan: Smoke: Verify Mode Switchboard loads for fleets with and without guarantees
Functional: Create/modify guarantees, verify change-event recorded, verify chart markers appear at commit times
Telemetry: Validate roll-forward chart values against raw telemetry queries for 1h/24h windows
Security: Ensure only fleet.write role sees edit controls and audit export endpoint requires admin scope
Rollback: Test revert modal flow for P0 and non-P0 fleets including canary promotion and abort
